ai.seo_question: What is the tree of Zaqqum in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the tree of Zaqqum (Zaqquum) is distinguished as a unique, natural creation in Hell rather than a metaphor, serving as the specific sustenance for the disbelievers (kuffar) as a form of divine retribution. Its description in Surah Ad-Dukhan highlights the physical reality of the afterlife, reinforcing the concept of 'Jaz'a' (recompense) where the nature of the punishment corresponds to the sins committed.
